home.heroTitle: The data club that thinks like a startup.
home.heroSub: Breaking traditional student club molds and building a modern structure that speaks the same language as global tech communities and agile tech startups.
home.whoP1: We're a student-run community at Marmara University turning curiosity about data into projects that ship. Instead of hierarchy and bureaucracy, we run on sprints, code reviews, and demos. Members work across six departments, ranging from exploratory analysis to production data engineering.
home.whoP2: Whether you're starting out with spreadsheets or already training models in PyTorch, there's a track for you here. You join a community that treats you as an active builder from day one rather than a passive attendee.
home.comingSoonSub: Our first projects are in the works. Check back soon to see what the crew is building.
home.deptTitle: One club, six ways to build
home.deptSub: Go deep in one track or move across teams. We ship real work in every department.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to build something with data?
home.ctaSub: Applications open every semester. There are no prerequisites; just bring your curiosity and drive to learn.

about.heroTitle: We work like a build crew, not a traditional student club.
about.storyP1: Most university clubs revolve around meetings, minutes, and hierarchy. We started the Data Science Club because we wanted the opposite: a modern structure that breaks traditional student club molds and works like the data teams at the tech companies and agile startups we admire.
about.storyP2: So we built our workflow around that idea. Six departments work together as cross-functional squads. Projects move forward in sprints. Knowledge is shared openly through code reviews and demos rather than kept in silos. New members ship something tangible in their first month, whether it's a chart, a model, or a data pipeline.
about.pullQuote: Rather than treating data as a raw commodity, we treat it like fertile ground and learn how to grow real products in it together.
about.storyP3: This creates a community that speaks the same language as global tech communities and agile startups. Our goal is for members to graduate having already practiced this engineering culture on real projects.
about.orgSub: The six core departments that form the backbone of our club work hand in hand with clear responsibilities, spanning technical production, event operations, financial sustainability, and communications.
about.flowSub: As the Marmara University Data Science Club, we are building a modern structure that breaks traditional student club molds and speaks the same language as global tech communities and agile tech startups. The six core departments that form our backbone work together with clear handoffs and well-defined responsibilities toward a shared vision.
